## 3.4.3 client side

### Errors

A CMSG reader that threw, or a translated SMSG with no 3.4.3 opcode, in the most recent session that had it; an error a later session no longer had is left out, and so is a missing opcode the 3.4.3 table has by now. "Code since" is the day of the last commit that changed the opcode's mentions, when it is later than the session: retest those.

| Opcode | Problem | Count | Session | Code since |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `SMSG_MOVE_SPLINE_SET_WALK_BACK_SPEED` | no 3.4.3 mapping | 2 | 20260910_221806 | 2026-10-21 |
| `SMSG_PET_STABLE_LIST` | no 3.4.3 mapping | 4 | 20260904_000444 | 2026-09-04 |

### Requests nothing answered

What the 3.4.3 client sent and no handler took, most recent session per opcode; a request that has a handler by now is left out. The client holds some windows until a request is answered, so these can hang a feature, not just lack one. "TrinityCore" says whether the native 3.4.3 server acts on the request (wotlk_classic `Opcodes.cpp`): one it ignores too is not waited for. Those it acts on are first.

| Opcode | TrinityCore wotlk_classic | Count | Session |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `0x329d` | ? | 28 | 20261023_000952 |
| `CMSG_SHOWING_CLOAK` | ? | 1 | 20260928_195745 |
| `CMSG_TIME_SYNC_RESPONSE_DROPPED` | ignores it | 1 | 20261022_231714 |
